title: a file whose attach fails stays for the next try, and the files before it stay attached
line: collect takes one file per transaction: two saved pages, the second of which fails after its rows are written, leave the first attached (its run logged, its original filed under the tree) and the second rolled back alone, in the inbox untouched and named with the failure; the next try attaches it, the object already in the archive harmless

steps.say: her Kentucky death records search saved from the fetch list into the download folder
John Young Davidson's memorial saved beside it, its name after the search's
the filing of the memorial's original is refused: the harness's stand-in for a file whose attach fails after its rows are written
collect: the search is attached and stays attached; the memorial's transaction fails and is rolled back alone

has: left in the inbox: failed: OSError:
the harness's stand-in for a filing refused

expect.why: the search reaches its step as it always does; the memorial's failure is named with the exception's type and message, on the line the tool prints
the search's run is committed in its own transaction: the memorial failing after it does not roll it back, though its original has left the inbox
the search left the download folder
and the inbox: it is filed under the tree, its rows committed
the memorial whose transaction failed is in the inbox, untouched, for the next try
nothing of the memorial's attach is left in the catalog

steps.say: the next try: tools/attach_inbox.py's own path over the memorial left in the inbox

expect.why: attached now: the object the failed try wrote into the archive is the same bytes under the same hash, and the artifact row is written new
